senses.en: deceptive or dishonest talk or behaviour

example.en: He dismissed the plan as pure humbug.
example.zh: 他斥责那个计划纯属骗局。

senses.en: to trick or deceive someone

example.en: They were humbugged into signing a bad contract.
example.zh: 他们被骗签了一份糟糕的合同。

senses.en: the land along the front of a building next to a street or water; the side facing it

example.en: The shop has a frontage of ten meters on the main road.
example.zh: 这家店铺临街面宽十米。

senses.en: a former British coin worth six pennies, no longer minted
senses.zh: 六便士硬币（旧英国币，已停铸）

example.en: She found an old sixpence in her grandmother's jewelry box.
example.zh: 她在奶奶的首饰盒里发现了一枚旧六便士硬币。

senses.en: always finding faults and criticizing in a petty way

example.en: He grew tired of her carping remarks.
example.zh: 他厌倦了她那些吹毛求疵的话。

senses.en: persistent petty criticism

example.en: Her constant carping discouraged the team.
example.zh: 她不断的挑剔使团队士气低落。

senses.en: to connect or divide words with a hyphen
senses.zh: 用连字符连接；加连字符

example.en: You should hyphenate compound adjectives such as well-known.
example.zh: 像 well-known 这样的复合形容词应该用连字符连接。

senses.en: vehicles that run on rails and carry people or goods

example.en: The trains to London run every half hour.
example.zh: 开往伦敦的火车每半小时一班。

senses.en: third-person form of train: to teach skills, or to practice
senses.zh: 训练；培训（train的第三人称单数）

example.en: She trains new employees every month.
example.zh: 她每个月培训新员工。

senses.en: to write or print a letter in capital form

example.en: Always capitalize the first word of a sentence.
example.zh: 句子的第一个单词总是要大写。

senses.en: to take full advantage of something

example.en: The company capitalized on the growing demand for electric cars.
example.zh: 这家公司充分利用了对电动汽车日益增长的需求。

senses.en: to provide a business with capital
senses.zh: 为（企业）提供资本，使资本化

example.en: The new venture was capitalized with ten million dollars.
example.zh: 这家新企业获得了1000万美元的资本投入。

senses.en: a person who plays a drum or drums

example.en: The drummer kept perfect time throughout the song.
example.zh: 鼓手整首歌都保持着精准的节奏。

senses.en: a difficult or unpleasant situation that is hard to get out of

example.en: She found herself in the predicament of having lost her passport abroad.
example.zh: 她发现自己陷入了在国外丢失护照的困境。

senses.en: an organized group of criminals

example.en: Police arrested a gang involved in car theft.
example.zh: 警方逮捕了一个参与汽车盗窃的团伙。

senses.en: an informal group of friends or young people who spend time together

example.en: A gang of kids was playing in the park.
example.zh: 一群孩子正在公园里玩耍。

senses.en: to join together with others as a group, often to do something

example.en: The neighbors ganged together to clean the street.
example.zh: 邻居们联合起来清扫街道。

senses.en: in the correct or suitable way

example.en: Please make sure the door is properly closed.
example.zh: 请确保门已正确关好。

senses.en: (British, informal) completely or really, used for emphasis
senses.zh: （英式，非正式）完全地；真正地；非常

example.en: The room was properly warm after the fire was lit.
example.zh: 炉火点着后，房间变得非常暖和。

senses.en: light in colour; almost white

example.en: She wore a pale blue dress.
example.zh: 她穿了一条浅蓝色的连衣裙。

senses.en: (of a person's face) having less colour than usual, especially from illness or fear

example.en: His face went pale when he heard the news.
example.zh: 听到这个消息时，他的脸色变得苍白。

senses.en: to become pale or lighter in colour

example.en: His face paled when he saw the letter.
example.zh: 看到那封信时，他的脸变苍白了。

senses.en: the process of forming or being formed

example.en: The formation of a new committee takes time.
example.zh: 新委员会的组建需要时间。

senses.en: a particular arrangement of people or things

example.en: The players lined up in a defensive formation.
example.zh: 球员们排成防守阵型。

senses.en: a natural structure or pattern of rock or land

example.en: This rock formation is popular with hikers.
example.zh: 这种岩石构造很受徒步者欢迎。

senses.en: to use rude or offensive words, especially when angry

example.en: He swore loudly when he dropped the box.
example.zh: 他箱子掉下来时大声咒骂。

senses.en: to make a serious promise or say formally that something is true

example.en: She swore to tell the truth in court.
example.zh: 她在法庭上发誓说实话。

senses.en: Casual trousers made of strong cotton cloth called denim.
senses.zh: 牛仔裤；用丹宁布制成的休闲裤

example.en: She wore a pair of blue jeans to the concert.
example.zh: 她穿了一条蓝色牛仔裤去听音乐会。

senses.en: relating to society and how it is organized

example.en: Social inequality remains a major issue.
example.zh: 社会不平等仍是一个主要问题。

senses.en: relating to meeting people and spending time with them

example.en: She has a busy social life.
example.zh: 她的社交生活很忙碌。

senses.en: an informal gathering organized by a group or club

example.en: The club is holding a social on Friday.
example.zh: 俱乐部将在周五举办一场联谊会。

senses.en: a weapon that fires bullets or shells from a metal tube

example.en: The police found a gun hidden in the abandoned car.
example.zh: 警方在废弃的汽车里发现了一把隐藏的枪。

senses.en: a device that forces out liquid, paint, or fasteners

example.en: He used a spray gun to paint the fence.
example.zh: 他用喷枪给栅栏上漆。

senses.en: to shoot someone or something with a gun

example.en: The poacher was arrested after he gunned down a protected bird.
example.zh: 那名偷猎者枪杀了一只受保护的鸟后被捕。

senses.en: a smaller group of people who differ from most people in a society by race, religion, language, or politics

example.en: The city has programs to support minority languages.
example.zh: 这座城市有支持少数民族语言的计划。

senses.en: the smaller number or part, especially less than half of a total

example.en: Only a minority of members voted against the plan.
example.zh: 只有少数成员投票反对该计划。

senses.en: a title used before a man's name, or a way of addressing a man politely
senses.zh: 先生（用于男子姓名前的尊称）

example.en: Mister Smith will see you now.
example.zh: 史密斯先生现在要见您。

senses.en: showing great energy and enthusiasm for a cause or goal

example.en: She is a zealous supporter of environmental protection.
example.zh: 她是环境保护的热心支持者。

senses.en: an aircraft that flies without an engine, supported by air currents

example.en: The glider circled silently above the valley.
example.zh: 滑翔机在山谷上空无声地盘旋。

senses.en: a person who glides, or a seat that swings back and forth smoothly
senses.zh: 滑行的人或物；摇摆摇椅

example.en: She rocked the baby gently in the glider.
example.zh: 她轻轻地在摇摆摇椅上哄着婴儿。

senses.en: the combining of two or more companies into one

example.en: The merger created the largest airline in the country.
example.zh: 这次合并造就了该国最大的航空公司。

senses.en: required by a rule or law; obligatory

example.en: Wearing a seat belt is mandatory in most countries.
example.zh: 在大多数国家，系安全带是强制性的。

senses.en: training or guidance given to help someone improve a skill

example.en: She received coaching before her first public speech.
example.zh: 她首次公开演讲前接受了指导。

senses.en: present participle of coach: training or teaching a person or team
senses.zh: 训练；指导（coach 的现在分词）

example.en: He is coaching the school football team.
example.zh: 他正在指导学校足球队。

senses.en: a person who gives advice, especially in a professional or academic setting

example.en: Students should meet their academic advisor each semester.
example.zh: 学生每学期都应与学业导师面谈。

senses.en: something that takes your attention away from what you are doing

example.en: Turn off your phone to avoid distractions while studying.
example.zh: 学习时请关掉手机以免分心。

senses.en: an activity that gives pleasant relief from worry or serious thought

example.en: Music is a welcome distraction after a stressful day.
example.zh: 忙碌一天后，音乐是一种令人愉快的消遣。

senses.en: a sandwich of a cooked patty served in a round bread bun

example.en: He ordered a burger and fries for lunch.
example.zh: 他午餐点了一个汉堡包和薯条。

senses.en: a number written with a decimal point, based on ten

example.en: Add the decimals carefully to get the right total.
example.zh: 仔细地把这些小数相加，才能得出正确的总数。

senses.en: based on the number ten
senses.zh: 十进制的；以十为基数的

example.en: Many countries use decimal currency with 100 smaller units in each main unit.
example.zh: 许多国家使用十进制货币，每个主单位等于100个较小的单位。

senses.en: toward the north

example.en: The birds flew northwards for the summer.
example.zh: 鸟儿们飞向北方过夏天。

senses.en: plural of hypothesis; proposed explanations for facts or observations that can be tested

example.en: The researchers tested two hypotheses before drawing conclusions.
example.zh: 研究人员在得出结论前检验了两个假设。

senses.en: a command from someone in authority that must be obeyed

example.en: The soldiers followed the captain's order without hesitation.
example.zh: 士兵们毫不犹豫地执行了上尉的命令。

senses.en: the way things are arranged or sequenced

example.en: Please list the names in alphabetical order.
example.zh: 请按字母顺序列出这些名字。

senses.en: to ask for food, goods or a service to be supplied

example.en: We ordered pizza for dinner last night.
example.zh: 我们昨晚点了比萨当晚餐。

senses.en: to tell someone to do something with authority

example.en: The judge ordered him to pay a fine.
example.zh: 法官命令他缴纳罚款。

senses.en: the act of taking part in an activity or event

example.en: Student participation makes classes more lively.
example.zh: 学生的参与让课堂更有活力。

senses.en: involvement or a share in something, such as profits or ownership

example.en: The company offered lenders a participation in future profits.
example.zh: 该公司向贷款方提供了未来利润的分成。

senses.en: sound or video that has been stored so it can be played back

example.en: I listened to an old recording of that song.
example.zh: 我听了那首歌的一段旧录音。

senses.en: the act of recording sound or images

example.en: The recording of the album took three months.
example.zh: 这张专辑的录制花了三个月。

senses.en: to change or adjust something again

example.en: He had to readjust the mirror after moving the car.
example.zh: 挪车后他得重新调整后视镜。

senses.en: to get used to a new situation after a change

example.en: It took her months to readjust to life at home.
example.zh: 她花了几个月才重新适应家里的生活。

senses.en: to astonish someone so much that they cannot speak

example.en: The announcement dumbfounded the audience.
example.zh: 这一宣布使观众惊愕不已。

senses.en: to persuade someone by flattery or gentle urging

example.en: She cajoled her brother into helping with the chores.
example.zh: 她哄得弟弟帮忙做家务。

senses.en: to change the order or positions of two or more things

example.en: She accidentally transposed the digits in his phone number.
example.zh: 她不小心把他电话号码里的数字顺序调换了。

senses.en: to move or transfer something to a different place, time, or context
senses.zh: 移置；迁移（到别处或别的时间）

example.en: The director transposed the story to modern-day Tokyo.
example.zh: 导演把故事移植到了现代东京。

senses.en: a matrix formed by interchanging the rows and columns of a given matrix

example.en: The transpose of a row matrix is a column matrix.
example.zh: 行矩阵的转置是列矩阵。

senses.en: showing very strong feeling or force; intense
senses.zh: 激烈的；强烈的；感情炽烈的

example.en: She made a vehement protest against the new policy.
example.zh: 她激烈抗议这项新政策。

senses.en: the use of methods or devices to prevent pregnancy

example.en: Talk to your doctor about which method of contraception suits you.
example.zh: 请向医生咨询哪种避孕方法适合你。

senses.en: a pause or gap in activity; an interruption

example.en: The band went on hiatus for two years.
example.zh: 乐队休整了两年。

senses.en: the most important or decisive point of a matter

example.en: The crux of the problem is lack of funding.
example.zh: 问题的症结在于缺乏资金。

senses.en: to become less strict or severe and give in to demands

example.en: After hours of begging, his parents finally relented and let him go.
example.zh: 哀求了几个小时后，父母终于松口让他去了。

senses.en: a team game played with an oval ball that can be carried and kicked

example.en: He plays rugby for his university team.
example.zh: 他在大学球队打橄榄球。

senses.en: a person with dark brown hair

example.en: The two sisters were a blonde and a brunette.
example.zh: 这对姐妹一个是金发，一个是深褐色头发。

senses.en: having dark brown hair

example.en: She has brunette hair and green eyes.
example.zh: 她一头深褐色头发，眼睛是绿色的。

senses.en: a decorative pin worn on clothing

example.en: She wore a silver brooch on her coat.
example.zh: 她在大衣上别了一枚银胸针。

senses.en: the thick main stem of a tree

example.en: The tree's trunk was covered in rough bark.
example.zh: 这棵树的树干上覆盖着粗糙的树皮。

senses.en: a large box or chest used for storing or carrying things

example.en: She kept old letters in a wooden trunk.
example.zh: 她把旧信件存放在一个木箱里。

senses.en: the long nose of an elephant

example.en: The elephant used its trunk to pick up a branch.
example.zh: 大象用鼻子捡起一根树枝。

senses.en: the luggage compartment at the back of a car

example.en: Put the bags in the trunk before we leave.
example.zh: 出发前把包放进后备箱。

senses.en: a single movement of the foot in walking

example.en: She took a step forward.
example.zh: 她向前迈了一步。

senses.en: a stage in a process

example.en: Learning the basics is the first step.
example.zh: 学习基础是第一步。

senses.en: a flat surface for placing the foot when going up or down

example.en: He sat on the bottom step.
example.zh: 他坐在最下面的台阶上。

senses.en: to move by lifting and setting down a foot

example.en: She stepped carefully over the puddle.
example.zh: 她小心地跨过水坑。

senses.en: a flat board fixed to a wall or inside furniture, used for holding things

example.en: She put the jars on the top shelf.
example.zh: 她把罐子放在最上层的架子上。

senses.en: a flat raised area of land or rock, especially under the sea
senses.zh: （陆地的）架状突出部分；（海底）大陆架

example.en: The continental shelf around the island is rich in fish.
example.zh: 该岛周围的大陆架鱼类资源丰富。

senses.en: the red liquid that flows through the body

example.en: The nurse took a sample of his blood.
example.zh: 护士取了他的血样。

senses.en: family origin or ancestry

example.en: She is of noble blood.
example.zh: 她出身贵族血统。

senses.en: to give a person or animal their first experience of bloodshed or hunting
senses.zh: 使初尝血腥；使初次体验狩猎

example.en: The young dog was blooded during the hunt.
example.zh: 那只幼犬在狩猎中初次尝到了血腥。

senses.en: the flesh around the base of the teeth

example.en: His gums were sore after the dental surgery.
example.zh: 牙科手术后他的牙龈很疼。

senses.en: a sweet substance for chewing

example.en: She chewed a piece of gum on the bus.
example.zh: 她在公交车上嚼了一片口香糖。

senses.en: a sticky substance from trees or plants used as glue

example.en: The tree produced a thick gum when its bark was cut.
example.zh: 树皮被割开后，树分泌出浓稠的树胶。

senses.en: to stick something with gum or glue

example.en: He gummed the label onto the package.
example.zh: 他把标签粘在包裹上。

senses.en: a tool with a heavy metal head on a handle, used for hitting nails

example.en: He used a hammer to drive the nail into the wood.
example.zh: 他用锤子把钉子敲进木头里。

senses.en: to hit something repeatedly with a hammer or similar blows

example.en: She hammered the nail into the wall.
example.zh: 她把钉子钉进墙里。

senses.en: to hit something hard many times, e.g. knocking on a door forcefully

example.en: Someone was hammering on the door.
example.zh: 有人在使劲敲门。

senses.en: to officially join or become connected with a larger organization

example.en: The research center is affiliated with the university.
example.zh: 该研究中心隶属于这所大学。

senses.en: a company or organization connected with or controlled by a larger one

example.en: The bank has affiliates in more than twenty countries.
example.zh: 这家银行在二十多个国家设有分支机构。

senses.en: serious and immediate danger

example.en: The climbers faced great peril on the icy mountain.
example.zh: 登山者在结冰的山上面临极大的危险。

senses.en: to put something or someone in danger

example.en: Rising debt could peril the company's future.
example.zh: 不断攀升的债务可能危及公司的未来。

senses.en: not final or definite; subject to change

example.en: We made a tentative plan to meet on Friday.
example.zh: 我们初步计划周五见面。

senses.en: hesitant and uncertain; done without confidence

example.en: She gave a tentative smile when she entered the room.
example.zh: 她进房间时露出一个怯生生的微笑。

senses.en: to attach or close something firmly

example.en: Please fasten your seatbelt before the plane takes off.
example.zh: 飞机起飞前请系好安全带。

senses.en: to become fixed or closed

example.en: This coat fastens with buttons.
example.zh: 这件外套用纽扣扣合。

senses.en: to hear something by chance, without the speakers knowing you are listening

example.en: I overheard them talking about the new project in the hallway.
example.zh: 我在走廊里无意中听到他们在谈论新项目。

senses.en: to make something weaker or less strong

example.en: The crisis weakened the country's economy.
example.zh: 这场危机削弱了该国的经济。

senses.en: to become weaker

example.en: His voice weakened as he grew tired.
example.zh: 他疲惫时声音变弱了。

senses.en: an idea or understanding of what something is like

example.en: His conception of freedom differs from mine.
example.zh: 他对自由的理解与我不同。

senses.en: the moment or process of becoming pregnant

example.en: The baby was conceived naturally, and conception occurred in May.
example.zh: 这个婴儿是自然受孕的，受孕发生在五月。

senses.en: armed conflict between countries or groups; war

example.en: Modern warfare often relies heavily on drones and technology.
example.zh: 现代战争往往严重依赖无人机和技术。

senses.en: intense struggle or competition between people or groups

example.en: The two departments have been engaged in budget warfare for months.
example.zh: 这两个部门几个月来一直在进行预算之争。

senses.en: to change the direction or course of something
senses.zh: 使转向；改变（路线、资金等的）用途

example.en: The road was closed, so traffic was diverted to another street.
example.zh: 道路封闭了，所以交通被改道到另一条街。

senses.en: to entertain or amuse someone

example.en: The game diverted the children for hours.
example.zh: 这个游戏让孩子们消遣了好几个小时。

senses.en: very noticeable or strong; clearly evident

example.en: She has a pronounced foreign accent.
example.zh: 她有明显的外国口音。

senses.en: to rub food against a rough surface to break it into small pieces

example.en: She grated some cheese over the pasta.
example.zh: 她在意大利面上擦了一些奶酪丝。

senses.en: to make an unpleasant rough sound by rubbing; to annoy someone
senses.zh: 发出刺耳的摩擦声；使烦躁，激怒

example.en: His constant complaining grates on my nerves.
example.zh: 他不停的抱怨让我心烦。

senses.en: a frame of metal bars, especially one holding fuel in a fireplace

example.en: The old house still has an iron grate in the fireplace.
example.zh: 这座老房子的壁炉里还装着铁炉栅。

senses.en: to perform or make something without preparation

example.en: The guitarist improvised a melody during the concert.
example.zh: 吉他手在音乐会上即兴创作了一段旋律。

senses.en: to manage with whatever is available

example.en: They improvised a shelter from blankets and branches.
example.zh: 他们用毯子和树枝临时搭了个栖身处。

senses.en: to cover food or pottery with a shiny coating
senses.zh: 给……上釉；给（食物）浇糖浆使表面光亮

example.en: She glazed the ham with honey before baking it.
example.zh: 她烤火腿前给它浇上了蜂蜜。

senses.en: a thin shiny coating on food or pottery

example.en: The doughnut is covered with a sweet glaze.
example.zh: 甜甜圈表面有一层甜糖浆。

senses.en: (of eyes) to become dull and lifeless

example.en: His eyes glazed over as the lecture continued.
example.zh: 讲座继续进行时，他的目光变得呆滞。

senses.en: dependent on or possible only if something else happens
senses.zh: 视条件而定的；偶然发生的

example.en: Our plans are contingent on the weather.
example.zh: 我们的计划取决于天气。

senses.en: a group of people representing a larger group or organization

example.en: A large contingent of fans traveled to the final.
example.zh: 大批球迷代表前往决赛现场。

senses.en: to gradually become smaller or less

example.en: Their savings dwindled after months without work.
example.zh: 几个月没有工作后，他们的积蓄逐渐减少。

senses.en: a rope or strap used to control a dog or other animal

example.en: Keep your dog on a leash in the park.
example.zh: 在公园里要给你的狗拴上牵引绳。

collocations: keep a dog on a leash

senses.en: to fasten an animal with a leash

example.en: She leashed the dog before their walk.
example.zh: 她散步前给狗拴上了牵引绳。

senses.en: one of the tiny blood vessels connecting arteries and veins

example.en: Oxygen passes from the lungs into the blood through the capillaries.
example.zh: 氧气通过毛细血管从肺部进入血液。

senses.en: a very thin tube, especially one that holds liquid by capillary action

example.en: Water rises in a capillary due to surface tension.
example.zh: 由于表面张力，水在毛细管中上升。

senses.en: long and slender with a very small internal diameter; relating to hair

example.en: The device contains a capillary channel for measuring tiny liquid volumes.
example.zh: 该装置含有一个用于测量微量液体的毛细通道。

senses.en: weak in body, especially because of old age

example.en: The infirm man needed help walking up the stairs.
example.zh: 这位体弱的老人上楼梯需要人搀扶。

senses.en: lacking firmness of will or purpose

example.en: He was too infirm of purpose to finish what he started.
example.zh: 他意志薄弱，无法坚持完成已经开始的事。

senses.en: the bending of light or sound as it passes from one medium to another

example.en: Refraction makes a straw look bent in a glass of water.
example.zh: 折射使吸管在杯水里看起来是弯的。

senses.en: a person blamed for the mistakes or wrongdoings of others

example.en: The manager made him the scapegoat for the failed project.
example.zh: 经理让他成了项目失败的替罪羊。

senses.en: to blame a person unfairly for something others did

example.en: Minority groups are often scapegoated in times of crisis.
example.zh: 少数群体在危机时期常被当作替罪羊。

senses.en: enthusiastic and prolonged applause from an audience

example.en: The singer received a standing ovation at the end of the concert.
example.zh: 音乐会结束时，歌手赢得了全场起立鼓掌。

senses.en: protected from bad weather, danger or difficulties

example.en: They found a sheltered spot by the rocks to eat lunch.
example.zh: 他们在岩石边找到一个避风的地方吃午饭。

senses.en: a flammable oil used as fuel in lamps and heaters

example.en: The old lamp burns kerosene.
example.zh: 那盏旧灯烧煤油。

senses.en: to flow or come out suddenly in a stream

example.en: Water spurted out of the broken pipe.
example.zh: 水从破裂的管子里喷了出来。

senses.en: a sudden short burst of speed, effort, or energy

example.en: He made a final spurt to reach the finish line first.
example.zh: 他最后冲刺，第一个到达终点线。

senses.en: intended to calm someone down or end a disagreement

example.en: He took a conciliatory tone to avoid further argument.
example.zh: 他采取了安抚的语气以避免更多争执。

senses.en: people who study science, especially by doing research and experiments

example.en: Scientists studied the effects of the new drug.
example.zh: 科学家们研究了这种新药的效果。
